rows.text: Once again, you arrive at the ruins of the city-state. Following the familiar path, you return to the cave where you once took shelter from the rain. The old man stands at the entrance to welcome you. He still looks spirited, while your face bears the marks of wind and frost.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Looks like you've been through a lot." He smiles, his wrinkles like the weathered bark of an old tree. "Now you must understand that there's no place for stateless folks like us out there. And I want nothing to do with either the black tide or the privileged elite."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Here, take this Sealing Wax and come live with me in the cave forever. There are many others here..." The old man unties the sack from his back.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Hardship and failure have worn down your edges, while calamity and strife have crushed your spirit. As you take the Sealing Wax from the elder's hand, a faint glow emerges from deep within the cave, like a burning flame.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Since then, you've never seen the blue sky outside the cave again.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Though you faced failure before, you haven't lost your courage and hope. The old man flashes a gap-toothed smile as you shoulder your well-packed bag, ready to challenge the land where black tides surge once more.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Since then, you've never returned to those caves.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
